full_judgment: 2. The dispute relates to a piece of land appertaining to SA Khatian No.955 of S.A. Khatian No.542 measuring an area of 16 decimals, situates at Bara Moghbazar, Dhaka. The parties are at loggerheads over the ownership of the said land and legal proceedings cropped up since 1961. One Shamsul Huda claiming title of the said plot along with another plot through one Biswanath instituted Title Suit No.170 of 1961 for declaration of title and cancellation of dead No.8142 dated 2nd September, 1961 against Shamsuzzoha Begum in the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Bakergonj, Barisal and got an ex-parte decree. According to the writ petitioner said Shamsuzzoha Begum sold the said property to Anis Fatema Begum, the predecessor of interest of the appellant Md. Jahangir Alam suppressing the decree passed in Title Suit No.170 of 1961. One Abdul Wahed Sarder, also instituted Title Suit No.371 of 1991 against aforesaid Anis Fatema and others in the First Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka for declaration of title and for further declaration that the deed of Anis Fatema is void, illegal and inoperative. The said suit was also decreed ex-parte on dated 23rd November, 1998. According to the writ petitioner in pursuance of the judgment of the civil Court he has been peacefully possessing the disputed land and filed several petition to the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka for mutation of the said land and while his petitions are awaiting decision, he was served with a notice by the writ respondent No.2 of dispossession for implementation of judgment in Writ Petition No.165 of 1998, and he was directed to hand over possession to the Kanoongo which compelled him to institute writ Petition No.408 of 2002 in the High Court Division seeking the above relief.
